sourceConflictNote: The official district page labels the download “2026-27 Approved Calendar,” but the linked PDF is titled “SY26-27 Calendar Draft (11.18.25),” carries a DRAFT watermark on all 12 pages, and lists 174 student working days on the first page but 176 on the last. The live district calendar currently labels August 24 for grades 9-12, while the Back-to-School page says grades 1-12 and the PDF calls it the student first day. This page uses August 24 for traditional grades 1-12, omits the disputed student-day total, and keeps the source under manual review.

customSections.label: What Changed for 2026–27
customSections.content: CMSD moved the traditional student start date to August 24 for the 2026–27 school year. Signal Cleveland reported that the one-week shift is connected to school mergers and other Building Brighter Futures changes. Some campuses also have new start and dismissal times, so families should confirm their school assignment and bell schedule before the first day.

customSections.label: Why the Student-Day Total Is Not Shown
customSections.content: CMSD's official calendar page calls the file approved, but the PDF retains a DRAFT watermark. Its July page lists 174 student working days and its June page lists 176. calendarFaqs.q: When does Cleveland Metropolitan School District start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Traditional students in grades 1–12 start Monday, August 24, 2026. The 205-day extended-year programs start August 10, kindergarten starts August 28, and Pre-K phases in September 1–4 before its first full day September 8.

calendarFaqs.q: When are CMSD Winter Break and Spring Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027, and students return January 4. Spring Break runs March 29 through April 2, 2027, and students return April 5.
